'''Tap code''' was a method of transmitting information via a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The [[Thief/Legends|pickpocket]] [[Zerba Cher'dak]] used tap code to communicate with his comrades during the [[Marblewood Estate heist]].<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
